resources.string: LibreUSOS talks directly to your university\'s USOS. You type your password only on the university\'s own page.
University not listed? Enter its USOS API address
Enter the USOS API address of your university. If it has no key for LibreUSOS yet, you can generate one yourself in 2 minutes.
There is no USOS API at this address. It usually starts with usosapi., usosapps. or apps.usos.
That does not look like an address. Enter all of it, for example https://usosapi.university.edu/
The address must start with https://
Stored encrypted with the Android Keystore. It never leaves your phone.
USOS rejected this key. Check the consumer key and consumer secret.
